## Checklist

- [ ] Document-Control block updated (version, effective date, Change History) for each document touched.
- [ ] `adr/README.md` index updated if an ADR was added or superseded.
- [ ] Root `README.md` index updated if a new document was added.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added.
- [ ] Mermaid diagrams render correctly (checked in GitHub preview).
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (markdownlint, detect-secrets, whitespace/tabs).
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, internal hostnames, or real tenant identifiers included.
- [ ] Owners/approvers referenced by **role**, not personal name.
- [ ] Commits are signed (GPG/SSH) and follow Conventional Commits.
